data.title: Venezuelans outside Caracas say capital not sharing blackout burden
data.description: SAN CRISTOBAL (VENEZUELA) - Josner Herrera is sick and tired of dealing with daily power cuts, especially when her part of western Venezuela produces a fair bit of electricity.

data.title: Fire at nursing home in Chile kills 16
data.description: SANTIAGO (CHILE) - A fire at a nursing home in Chile that had previously violated regulations has killed 16 elderly residents and left others hospitalized, authorities said Saturday.

data.title: Yemen government forces say hit Houthis in Red Sea city
data.description: DUBAI - Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces said Saturday that they had struck Iran-allied Houthi fighters in the Red Sea city of Mocha, as the number of civilians forced to flee the renewed fighting soared.

data.title: Argentina revives plan for South Atlantic naval base amid Falklands tensions
data.description: USHUAIA (ARGENTINA) - Along the Beagle Channel, an icy stretch of water at the southern tip of the Americas, a concrete slab rises from hills covered in low, brownish scrub.

data.title: Hull hold Chelsea, Liverpool fail to beat Fulham in Premier League
data.description: LONDON - Hull held free-scoring Chelsea 2-2 at Stamford Bridge to go third in the Premier League as Liverpool failed to find a way past struggling Fulham in a 0-0 draw on Saturday.

data.title: 'Great to have a race at home': Fans celebrate F1's Madrid return
data.description: MADRID - Forty-five years after Formula 1 last roared around Madrid, the Spanish capital is celebrating its return this weekend with a brand-new circuit, accessible from the city centre via only a metro ride.

data.title: Anthropic boss calls for slowing pace of AI development
data.description: NEW YORK - Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Saturday called on artificial intelligence (AI) firms to slow down the development of the powerful technology, amid mounting worries over the risks of "superintelligent" computer systems.

data.title: Stunning US fightback sets up Solheim Cup singles showdown
data.description: THE HAGUE - Europe and the United States will head into Sunday's decisive Solheim Cup singles level on points after a breathtaking rearguard action by the Americans in a nail-biting afternoon fourball session.

data.title: Danish WWII drama wins top prize at Venice festival
data.description: VENICE (ITALY) - The Venice Film Festival awarded its top prize on Saturday to a Danish-made drama about a woman trying to hide a wartime relationship with a Nazi -- the only feature film with a female director in the competition.

data.title: No-confidence motion ‘to be filed this month’
data.description: Opposition parties will submit a no-confidence motion against the government within this month, with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Digital Economy Minister Chaichanok Chidchob the main targets, People’s Party list-MP Parit Wacharasindhu confirmed on Saturday.

data.title: Nene Royal rocking Phuket before AGT final
data.description: Local busker-turned-rock star Nene Royal is inviting fans to attend her live show on Saturday night at Naka Night Market, where she began her music journey in her home province of Phuket — her final show before she flies to the United States to compete in the America’s Got Talent final.

data.title: Zelensky willing to meet Putin at G20 in Miami
data.description: BERLIN - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he would be willing to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a G20 summit in December, in an interview released on Saturday, as efforts intensify to end the conflict.

data.title: French police suspect train derailment was sabotage
data.description: CLEON, France - Investigators suspect that a train derailment in northwest France which injured 44, one gravely, was the result of sabotage, a police source told AFP on Saturday.

data.title: Phuket Jewish New Year event cancelled on security grounds
data.description: A Jewish New Year celebration in Phuket was cancelled at the last minute on Friday evening because of concerns raised by Israeli security officials, organisers said.

data.title: ONE Championship: Yod-IQ says Jonathan Haggerty needs Muay Thai win before title shot
data.description: Thailand’s Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri says British rival Jonathan Haggerty should earn a win in Muay Thai before challenging for his newly claimed ONE Championship bantamweight belt – and is serious about going after the Englishman’s kickboxing crown instead.

data.title: Bangkok Blue Line train disrupted, passengers diverted
data.description: Passengers using the MRT Blue Line in Bangkok on Saturday afternoon were forced to alter their routes after a signalling system failure suspended services on a 12-station stretch for more than two hours before repairs were completed.

data.title: Trump lands in Ireland for golf and diplomacy
data.description: DUBLIN - Donald Trump landed in Ireland under tight security Saturday for two days of diplomacy and golf, on a trip that again blurs the lines between his presidency and personal business interests.

data.title: Anxiety grows in Europe over ‘pervert’ AI glasses
data.description: Calls are growing louder in Europe for action against “pervert” smart glasses after secretly filmed video of girls and women appeared online — with a petition in Britain demanding a ban on their sale.

data.title: Bangchak says no leaks found in Bangkok fuel pipeline
data.description: Bangchak Group said no leaks were found in a fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Klong Toey district of Bangkok following an inspection after thousands of litres of oil-contaminated wastewater were reported in the area.

data.title: Xi Jinping lands in India for Brics summit
data.description: NEW DELHI - Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi on Saturday for a Brics summit alongside leaders from India, Russia and Iran as wars, trade and energy test the divided grouping.

data.title: Pathum Thani bank robbery suspect arrested in Bangkok
data.description: PATHUM THANI - Police have arrested a man accused of robbing a bank at gunpoint in Khlong Luang district and later setting fire to the car used in the heist to destroy evidence.

data.title: Phuket property market hits 705bn baht as foreign buyers drive resort demand
data.description: Phuket has more than 90,000 residential units worth 705 billion baht on the market, with resort properties accounting for 52% of supply and foreign demand driving growth.
